notes.title: War of the Gods: Prologue Edition Launches for Free Today
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for liking “War of the Gods: Infinite Epic”, so we officially launched the version of “War of the Gods: Prologue” today, offering it to players who like [War of the Gods].

You can experience the first weekly content of the game for free in this version, if you like [War of the Gods] you can buy the full version in the following page, the full version has a superb content:
1, 6 world chapters of different bosses different experience
2、9 different characteristics of the protagonist can be operated
3、More than 600+ equipment can be obtained
4, 200 + different follower waiting for you to unlock!

The full version of the content is absolutely large and full!
